notes.taffy_evaluation: taffy 0.14.0, MIT (docs.rs latest page read); pure-Rust status, f32 vs f64 geometry and negative-gap behaviour were NOT stated by the page read and remain UNVERIFIED. Not adopted: the spec contract has checkable differences from CSS flex (container AUTO/FIXED plus child HUG/FILL/FIXED must agree, grow limited to 0|1, SPACE_BETWEEN as a primary-align mode, negative gaps legal, absolute children fall back to constraints, f64 point determinism). No dep request filed
spec_gaps_slice2: grow distribution semantics (equal share vs flex-basis content share) not stated; implemented equal share, relation to Figma UNVERIFIED
overflow alignment: centre/max of an overflowing line packs to the start (no negative offsets); children never shrink; both unspecified
SPACE_BETWEEN with overflow: gap floors at 0; with one item packs to start; unspecified
container AUTO/FIXED modes and child layout_sizing are redundant in STU-DS-144/148; chosen: both must agree (InconsistentSizing)
STU-DS-045 strokes_included_in_layout: how stroke weight enters spacing is unspecified, so true is refused
plain-frame children paint_rank = document order (last on top); auto-layout default first-on-top follows item_reverse_z_index false; both UNVERIFIED against Figma
paddings/spacing use the studio_declared hard bounds of STU-DS-145 (gaps -10000..100000, padding 0..100000); 2 dp precision not enforced
hugging leaf uses authored width/height as intrinsic content; text measurement is Layout/Type scope
wrap + FILL primary child, wrap + hug primary, hug on a plain frame are refused rather than guessed
folio_needs: No design frame / auto-layout frame node: LayoutNode/AutoLayout/Placement are crate-local; Folio needs layout_mode, wrap, axis sizing modes, align fields, spacing/padding, clamps and per-child layout_align/grow/positioning/sizing (STU-DS-144/148/149) plus constraints per child (STU-DS-152)

No component, component_set, component_instance, variable, variable_collection or reaction record types; no per-node reactions (STU-PRO-103), component_property_references (STU-DS-113) or explicit_variable_modes (STU-DS-132)
Folio Resolver::primitive for SCIN-*/SCMP-*/SVAR-* is host-owned; INSTANCE_LAYER_BINDING is provided for primitive_layer_binding
not_proven: no Figma/Adobe oracle for auto layout (hand-computed only); wrap fill/stretch interplay, min-clamp on the cross axis and nested wrap containers have no dedicated case
performance: content_size is recomputed per level (O(nodes x depth)); no memoisation; not measured at 4096 nodes
